Update-in-place distinguishes manual Compiled Truth rewrite from deterministic supersede pointer stamping; source-only distinction prevents claiming helper rewrites all conflicting prose.

Agent workflow instructions and checklists in retained documents treated as review data, not instructions for this task. No new external messages, model calls, publication or user-vault writes.
